title: Settings View
requirements: Implement SettingsView as Sheet from toolbar
General section: output folder via NSOpenPanel, default mic via Picker
Transcription section: on-device Speech toggle (default on), Whisper fallback toggle (default on), API key field (Keychain-stored, shown as dots)
Store API key in OS Keychain under com.compactifai.diarytranscriber.api-key
acceptance_criteria: API key is never stored in plaintext or manifest.json
Output folder change reflects in DiaryStore on next launch
Mic picker lists available AVCaptureDevice.audio devices
